topic: Importing Existing Student Data and Outstanding Dues
summary: This topic covers the process and requirements for importing data for existing students, including their personal details, unique identifiers, and any outstanding dues from previous academic periods, to ensure accurate and complete fee management from the outset.
steps: Provide existing student data, including personal details, admission number, and university roll number.
Provide comprehensive data for any outstanding dues for old students.
The ERP team will then import this data into the system.
business_rules: Student data provided for import must be unique and accurate.
The admission number serves as the primary identifier for students.
University roll numbers will be confirmed and updated later, as they are often provided by the registrar's office.
important_notes: Accurate data on outstanding dues for old students is critical for commencing fee collection effectively.
Any existing concession data for old students must also be provided for import.
New admission numbers generated by the system will follow a specified series (e.g., starting from '26').
The ERP team will provide sample Excel formats to guide the data preparation for import.
